question: Who, among the following, was not a Sultan of Slave dynasty?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Mubarak Shah__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Mubarak Shah, also called Mubarak Khan, was the son of Alauddin Khilji and belongs to Khilji Dynasty. Hence, option 1 is the correct answer.**
 
• Mubarak Shah ascended the throne with the title Qutubuddin on 14 April 1316, when he was 17 or 18 years old.
 
• He assumed the title** Khalifatullah (Caliph)**, which appears on his coins.
 
• Mubarak Shah abolished severe fines and taxes and prohibited the revenue ministry from using harsh measures such as flogging and imprisonment to recover taxes reviving the petition system.
 
• He also revoked Alauddin’s price control measures, leading to increased inflation.
 
• **He was murdered by Khusro Khan in 1320, which ended the Khilji dynasty.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **The list of Sultans belonging to the Slave Dynasty**

 
 
• Qutb ud-Din Aibak (1206-1210 AD)
 
• **Aram Shah (1210-1211 AD)**
 
• Iltutmish (1211-1236 AD)
 
• Rukn-ud-din Feroze (1236 AD)
 
• Razia al-Din (1236-1240 AD)
 
• **Muiz-ud-din Bahram Shah (1240-1242 AD)**
 
• **Ala-ud-din Masud Shah (1242-1246 AD)**
 
• Nasiruddin Mahmud Shah (1246-1266 AD)
 
• Ghiyas-ud-din Balban (1266-1286 AD)
 
• Muiz-ud-din Muhammad Qaiqabad (1286-1290 AD)
